2608.28549.title: Video Generative Models as Geometry Learner
2608.28549.paper_summary: Recent generative approaches to geometry estimation adapt pretrained image diffusion models and treat the task as image-conditioned generation. Leveraging off-the-shelf image diffusion models, they either (i) train task-specific geometry models (for depth and surface normal estimation) independently, losing the opportunity of exploring the intrinsic correlation of these geometric targets, or (ii) jointly fine-tune modified image diffusion backbones (e.g., altered self-attention), which typically demands substantial labeled data. To overcome these limitations in a principled fashion, we repurpose pretrained video generative models as a unified and data-efficient framework for geometry estimation, formulated innovatively as a next-frames prediction task. Our method, GeoNeXt, inherits naturally structured knowledge and richer priors from the video model, while further adapting them for joint modeling of images and geometry targets (image <-> geometry), enabling more data efficient and effective learning of geometry. Extensive experiments validate our method for zero-shot monocular depth and surface normal estimation across diverse datasets, outperforming both previous task-specific and unified generative competitors while using substantially less training data. Notably, our method rivals discriminative state-of-the-art approaches trained on over 100x more data and even standouts on several benchmarks.
2608.28549.paper_summary_zh: 最近的幾何估計生成方法適應了預訓練的圖像擴散模型，並將任務視為圖像條件生成。利用現成的圖像擴散模型，它們要麼 (i) 獨立訓練特定任務的幾何模型（用於深度和表面法線估計），失去了探索這些幾何目標內在相關性的機會，要麼 (ii) 聯合微調修改過的圖像擴散骨幹（例如，改變的自注意力），這通常需要大量標記數據。為了以原則性的方式克服這些限制，我們將預訓練的視頻生成模型重新用作幾何估計的統一且數據高效的框架，並創新性地將其表述為下一幀預測任務。我們的方法 GeoNeXt 自然繼承了視頻模型中的結構化知識和更豐富的先驗，同時進一步調整它們以聯合建模圖像和幾何目標（圖像 <-> 幾何），使幾何的學習更加數據高效和有效。大量實驗驗證了我們的方法在多樣數據集上的零樣本單眼深度和表面法線估計中表現優異，超越了之前的特定任務和統一生成競爭者，同時使用的訓練數據顯著更少。值得注意的是，我們的方法與在超過 100 倍數據上訓練的判別最先進方法相抗衡，並在幾個基準測試中脫穎而出。
